tweet.text:
On #InternationalCatDay, we're tipping our hats to F. D. C. Willard, the only feline coauthor in physics history! In 1975, Willard — AKA Chester — was listed as an author on a #physics paper in @PhysRevLett: https://go.aps.org/3ONv9Gv. 

📷  Google Scholar
